newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha steady, swaps reflect low volatility.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha steady, swaps reflect low volatility.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices held steady on Thursday but trade was thin and prices talked in a slightly wider bid/ask range as German regional holidays further dampened already thin demand, traders said.
The cargo market held a small contango with prompt cargoes talked around $186/$189 a tonne cif NWE with July paper showing a $1-2 per tonne premium.
Swaps reflected the market's limited volatility with June and July contracts talking flat around $188/$189 and $188.50/$189.50 respectively.
Barge talk was thin with a public holiday keeping demand from Germany subdued. Prompt liftings were notionally pegged around $182/$185 fob ARA.
